name: button-group
title: Button Group
summary: Buttons joined into one control, such as a split button or a toolbar segment.
description: Buttons joined into one control: a split button, a set of related actions, a toolbar segment. The children are real Buttons (or Toggles, or a Menu's trigger); the group only joins them: the inner corners go square, neighbours share one hairline, a focused button rises above its neighbours. Horizontal or vertical. JSON specs can list the buttons as items. Not a single choice: that is the segmented control.

anatomy.description: role=group with an aria-label; an inline flex row (a column when vertical) with no gap. Its direct children lose the radius of their inner corners (logical: start and end, mirrored right-to-left; top and bottom when vertical). Each child's ring overlaps the previous child's edge, so a join is one 1px hairline. A focused child (and the pressed one) sits above its neighbours. Vertical: children stretch to the widest and use radius.control (a pill cannot be split top to bottom).
A Button made from the items prop, marked data-button-group="item"; it takes the group's variant, size and shape.

items.description: Buttons as data, rendered before the children: { value, label, disabled? }. A click calls onItemClick(value).

variant.description: The Button variant of the items (children set their own).

size.description: The Button size of the items: xs 24px, sm 28px, md 32px, lg 36px.

shape.description: The Button shape of the items. Left out, the app's shape: a pill, or rounded in a rounded app ("shape": "rounded" in the project's fndn.json). Named: pill (the group's outer ends are round) or rounded.

slots.default: Buttons, Toggles or a Menu with its trigger, after the items.

events.itemClick: (value: string) after a click on an item

keyboard: Tab reaches each button in turn (a group is not a single tab stop: it is several actions, not one choice)
Enter / Space activate the focused button
notes: Give the group a label that names what its buttons act on ("Text alignment", "Merge options").
Icon-only buttons in it still need their own name (tooltip or aria-label).

motion: press: the boxes stay still. A joined button never scales (the join would open) and the group is not scaled either; the pressed button's label and icon dip inside it (motion.press-scale-sm over duration.press), from the pointer only
hover: the Buttons' own fills over duration.fast (pointer only)
